description: This Java source file defines the StreamDataService class which provides a thread-safe way to convert data from OutputStream to InputStream, facilitating streaming data without loading all data into memory. It includes inner classes for stream handling via queues, methods to run data writing in separate threads, and integrates with Spring's TaskExecutor.

classes.name: StreamDataService
classes.description: A Spring service that allows streaming data between threads using a queue mechanism or in-memory buffer if data size permits.

classes.name: QueueInputStream
classes.description: InputStream implementation that reads data from a BlockingQueue, managing stream completion and exceptions.

classes.name: QueueOutputStream
classes.description: OutputStream implementation that writes data into a QueueInputStream, signaling end of stream and handling exceptions.

methods.name: streamData
methods.description: Streams data generated by a StreamDataWriter either via in-memory buffer for small data or in a separate thread for larger data, returning an InputStream.
